{{Quote|His&hellip;I'm certain of it.|Ki-Adi-Mundi|<ref name="SWRO" />}}
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sharad Hett]] used this '''lightsaber''' during his career as a Jedi Knight, and it remained at his side in his self-imposed exile on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] recalled the blade being green,<ref name="Kenobi" /> but the blade was red during Sharad's time as a warlord.<ref name="SWRO" />
[[File:HettsSaveMundi-SWREP10.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Hett, his son and Ki-Adi-Mundi battle a canyon krayt dragon.]]
When a report reached the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] of a Tusken Raider using a lightsaber while leading a massive Tusken war band, the saber correlated to a historical [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of Hett. Due to his fame, it was instantly recognizable to many Jedi including [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], who had trained him. It was this clue that led the Jedi to identify the man wielding it as Hett himself.<ref name="SWRO" />

He used it to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and before becoming one with the Force, after she stabbed him in the chest, Hett gave his lightsaber to his son, [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]],<ref name="SWRO" /> who would wield it throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Enemy Lines">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref><ref name="Siege">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref> However, decades later, A'Sharad pledged himself to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and became [[Darth Krayt]]. It is unknown if the weapon was still in his possession at that time.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
